name: agentic-sdlc
description: An end-to-end agentic software development lifecycle: a Product Manager agent turns a raw idea into researched GitHub epics and atomic, fully-expanded issues; a Dispatcher batches them into parallel-safe waves you approve; concurrent Tech Lead pipelines drive each issue through strategy, architecture, development, code review, quality, and platform operations; an Integrator reconciles the parallel work; and a Retrospective keeps the accumulated debt paid down.
